column1: # large-subset-rejected-envs.tsv: rejected snippets of the work list, run in dash and bash --posix in the base
# environment and in example environments made by reading them (large-subset-rejected-setups.jsonl; make
# corpus-rejected-envs), compared as large-subset-rejected.pl compares.  Columns (tab): id; over all its environments:
# alike in every one, alike in some, differ in every one; each environment's outcome (dash's status/bash's status);
# what each environment does; the text (⏎: a newline).
# Column 5 (the text) is not shipped; to restore it: perl -Ilib doc/large-subset/tools/large-subset-restore.pl
#   (from the distribution's directory; needs: corpus-work/samples.jsonl, made by make corpora corpus-samples; no shell
